purpose: Planning contract for distinct YouTube Shorts, organic TikTok, and TikTok advertising targets. It does not authorize publication or establish creative quotas.

scope_rules.shared_layer: Reviewed source meaning, transcript, visual anchors, provenance, and production quality rules may be shared.
scope_rules.derived_layer: Opening, beat map, crop, captions, sound, cover, metadata, interaction, rights, export, and analytics must be reviewed per platform target.
scope_rules.no_transfer: Advertising recommendations and performance figures must not become organic defaults. Short-form conventions must not become long-form defaults.
scope_rules.no_universal_cadence: No fixed cut, zoom, caption, sound-effect, hook, loop, or pattern-interrupt interval is supported.
scope_rules.versioning: Every platform rule and safe-area profile records a source, verification date, placement, account context, locale direction, and version.

platform_targets.purpose: Comparison boundary, not a new deliverable target in this contract.
platform_targets.opening_contract: Promptly fulfill the clicked title-thumbnail promise and establish the value and scope.
platform_targets.analytics_contract: Keep traffic source, comparable duration, audience, packaging, and retention context.

platform_targets.classification: For standard channels, square or vertical uploads up to three minutes uploaded after 2024-10-15 are categorized as Shorts.
platform_targets.product_default_canvas: 1080x1920 9:16 progressive; a Studio interoperability default, not the full platform acceptance envelope
platform_targets.opening_contract: Make the premise and promised value recognizable immediately without deleting necessary context.
platform_targets.packaging_contract: Opening frame for feed acquisition plus title and thumbnail or selected-frame behavior on other surfaces. Current official thumbnail pages expose differing workflows, so capability detection is required.
platform_targets.link_contract: Ordinary URLs in Shorts comments and descriptions are non-clickable; eligible related-video links are clickable.
platform_targets.music_contract: Library duration varies by song. A Short over one minute with an active claim is blocked globally. Preserve clean audio and claim provenance.

platform_targets.classification: Organic TikTok post created or uploaded through available TikTok or TikTok Studio tools; do not infer an ideal duration from the upload maximum.
platform_targets.product_default_canvas: 1080x1920 9:16 progressive; a full-screen production default, not a claim that all accepted posts require it
platform_targets.opening_contract: Make subject and value legible before a viewer skips; preserve an authentic creator voice and necessary context.
platform_targets.packaging_contract: Opening and first frame operate in feed; a selected cover represents the post in profile and search contexts.
platform_targets.music_contract: When promoting a brand, product, or service, prefer the Commercial Music Library. External or original sound requires documented rights and the applicable confirmation.
platform_targets.monetization_note: Creator Rewards currently defines qualifying original high-quality content as longer than one minute, so short duration cannot be a universal product rule.
platform_targets.analytics_contract: Retain the exact account-exported TikTok metric names and definitions, platform surface, watch/skip context, shares, saves, follows, search context, duration, sound/remix context, and observation window.

platform_targets.classification: Paid or Spark/non-Spark campaign creative governed by the selected placement and campaign contract.
platform_targets.evidence_boundary: Hook timing, CTA, recall, conversion, safe-zone, and creative benchmarks from TikTok for Business remain advertising-scoped unless organic evidence independently supports transfer.

editorial_patterns.name: Immediate, honest premise
editorial_patterns.goal: Give the viewer enough information to decide that the promised value is relevant.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Reveal the subject, question, outcome, conflict, or useful action immediately in picture, speech, or readable text; then support it.
avoid: withholding all value until the last frame

evidence.scope: platform convergence; precise second counts are context- and ad-specific

editorial_patterns.name: Native vertical composition
editorial_patterns.goal: Use the phone viewport fluently without losing source meaning.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Reframe per shot around faces, hands, demonstrations, evidence, and readable text; preserve the uncropped master and manual override.
avoid: crop inferred from face position alone

evidence.scope: platform guidance plus mobile vertical-video experiment

editorial_patterns.name: Single dominant visual task
editorial_patterns.goal: Keep attention on the information or performance that matters.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Define a focal subject and keep captions, evidence, and motion subordinate; add a split only when the second view supplies necessary information.

evidence.scope: attention research; short-form split-screen evidence remains exploratory

editorial_patterns.name: Verified, glance-readable captions
editorial_patterns.goal: Preserve access and comprehension in a small, UI-obstructed viewport.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Maintain accurate timed captions and optionally derive a concise burned-in emphasis layer with controlled line length, dwell time, contrast, and collision checks.
avoid: essential text outside the safe area

evidence.scope: accessibility and platform caption guidance; performance effects are contextual

editorial_patterns.name: Motivated short-form rhythm
editorial_patterns.goal: Maintain orientation and forward movement in a compressed beat map.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Cut, reframe, reveal text, or change sound at a meaningful change in information, action, viewpoint, emotion, or section.

evidence.scope: editing and attention research; no universal cadence

editorial_patterns.name: Platform-native sound with rights binding
editorial_patterns.goal: Use speech, music, and sound as narrative, discovery, or participation elements without assuming cross-platform rights.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Start from a clean dialogue master; select and document sound separately for each platform, territory, account type, and commercial purpose.
avoid: exporting licensed in-app audio to another platform

editorial_patterns.name: Honest payoff and platform-valid bridge
editorial_patterns.goal: Resolve the promised unit and offer an available next action.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Choose a conclusion, natural callback, related YouTube video, comment prompt, follow-up, participation request, or ad CTA that exists on the target surface.
avoid: spoken link-in-description where the link is not clickable
organic CTA copied from an ad

evidence.scope: platform interaction contracts; creative performance is contextual

editorial_patterns.name: Source-grounded clip adaptation
editorial_patterns.goal: Repurpose a longer source without stripping meaning or originality.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Select a self-contained claim or scene from the reviewed source, add the minimum context and original interpretation needed, and preserve attribution and provenance.
avoid: deriving one platform output from another compressed output

evidence.scope: production truth rules plus platform originality policies

editorial_patterns.name: Surface-aware cover and first frame
editorial_patterns.goal: Represent the same content accurately across feed, profile, search, Home, and channel surfaces.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Review the opening frame and cover/thumbnail as distinct but coordinated assets; keep branding recognizable and video-specific content dominant.
avoid: cover text that never pays off
assuming the cover controls the swipe-feed opening

evidence.scope: platform surface capabilities; performance is channel-specific

editorial_patterns.name: Native-metric hypothesis learning
editorial_patterns.goal: Improve decisions without mistaking correlation or incompatible metrics for causation.
editorial_patterns.recipe: Store native metric names, definitions, denominators, surface, cohort, window, hypothesis, confounds, and owner interpretation before proposing a controlled change.

evidence.scope: platform analytics guidance and research-method boundary
